pages.text: A smiling face appears as Vivi the video call begins. Even far away, friends feel close.
Pictures and voices travel together. Video calls send moving images and sound at the same time.
A camera shows faces while a microphone hears voices. Both work together to share the moment.
The internet carries tiny pieces of data very fast. That speed keeps video calls smooth.
Families use video calls to talk, wave, and laugh when they cannot meet in person.
Seeing faces helps people understand feelings. Smiles and nods share meaning without words.
Buttons help start and end calls. People decide when to join and when to say goodbye.
Video calls need electricity and internet. Without power or connection, screens go quiet.
Being polite matters online. Waiting turns and listening helps everyone feel heard.
When the call ends, Vivi rests. Faces may disappear, but feelings of togetherness remain.
